conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Speaking of common human needs, the ancient Mesopotamians were among the first to develop complex legal codes, like the Code of Hammurabi, to govern their societies.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: user_agent
